headline: Türkiye to Propose 35% Global Electrification Target at COP31
summary: The upcoming COP31 climate conference in Antalya, Türkiye, will focus on a voluntary pledge to reach 35 percent global electrification by 2035. The host nation aims to secure international commitments to accelerate energy transition goals.
why: COP summits are major international forums where climate policy commitments are negotiated, often influencing global energy investment trends and regulatory frameworks for the power and automotive sectors.

impacts.name: Utilities
impacts.why: Global electrification targets directly impact the long-term infrastructure requirements and capital expenditure plans for utility companies.
